chronology.text: Live television and radio presenting — Zhengding County Television and Hebei Traffic Radio; Spring Festival broadcasts reached audiences above 500,000.
Presenter and producer, University Radio York 88.3FM.
On-ground coordination in the rescue of a transgender woman forcibly detained in a conversion-therapy facility in Jinan.
Volunteer writer at Beijing LGBT Center; transgender-support volunteer at Wuhan LGBT Center, including emergency PEP access.
Script supervisor, translator and researcher on University of York productions; two works selected for the 14th Macao International Microfilm Festival and a Golden Rooster screening programme.

ci.meta_title: Sixteen Poems of A and B · Hanpu Li
ci.meta_description: A sixteen-poem cycle by one author in two voices, with the Chinese source text and translation.
ci.heading: Sixteen Poems of A and B
ci.subtitle: A sixteen-poem cycle written by one author in two voices, A (甲) and B (乙). A usually gives a prefatory account; B’s first five poems are untitled. The cycle is dated 9 June 2026. Three poems outside it follow: one dated 1 July and two dated 9 September. The author’s annotations are available on request.
